title: Long Diagonal Finish
setup: Black's king sits on g8, and an entirely empty long diagonal runs from a1 to the corner beside it.
hint: First push the king to the square where one single diagonal decides everything. Which diagonal is that?
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Qg6+}} drives the king to the corner, and {{Kh8}} is forced. The a1–h8 diagonal is completely empty, so {{Bb2#}} arrives with check while the queen covers g7, g8 and h7. The bishop on b8 is shut in by its own pawn.
